note: Canonical extraction records (catalogue/report contract section 2a, amendment A3) for text-plain draft-1 and its limit configuration, derived from the hand-derived vectors without new hand work. text-markdown records are deferred until its re-review settles where `masked` goes.

records.description: Empty input: zero tokens, insufficient-tokens, no k-grams.
Only White_Space (SP, TAB, CR, LF, NBSP, IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE): all separators, zero tokens.
Punctuation and symbols only (General_Category P*, S*): zero tokens.
Five tokens, fewer than k = 8: insufficient-tokens, tokens listed, no k-grams.
Exactly k = 8 tokens: one k-gram, partial window.
12 tokens (k <= n < k + w - 1 = 15): m = 5 < w, one partial window.
Exactly k + w - 1 = 15 tokens: m = 8 = w, one full window, not partial.
Period-3 cycle of 24 tokens: k-gram hashes repeat with period 3, so windows hold equal minima and the rightmost is selected.
20 identical tokens: every k-gram hash is equal; each window selects its last position.
Reference paragraph, wrapped at about 60 columns with LF.
Same words, one long line with doubled spaces, a TAB and trailing spaces: identical hashes in every channel.
Reference paragraph with CRLF line ends: CR is White_Space, so tokens and hashes equal plain-reflow-a; spans shift.
U+FEFF at offset 0 followed by the reference paragraph: the BOM is Default_Ignorable, never inside a token; spans keep original offsets (first token starts at 3).
Reference paragraph in capitals: exact channel differs, folded and skeleton identical to plain-reflow-a.

ZWSP, ZWNJ, ZWJ, WORD JOINER and SOFT HYPHEN inside words; a ZWSP between spaces. Default_Ignorable code points are transparent inside a token: exact text keeps them, folded deletes them, so folded and skeleton equal plain-reflow-a.
ZWSP used as the only separator between words joins them into one token (a stated limit for scripts that use ZWSP as a word separator).

Other Default_Ignorable code points: CGJ, VS16, a TAG letter, LRM, MONGOLIAN VOWEL SEPARATOR and U+FEFF inside words; leading and trailing ignorables outside the span; a HANGUL FILLER alone is no token.
French sentence in NFC.
The same sentence in NFD: combining marks are word characters, exact text differs, folded (NFC) and skeleton equal plain-nfc.
U+FB01, U+FB02 and U+FB03 ligatures expand under NFKC: folded equals the ASCII spelling.
ASCII spelling of plain-nfkc-ligature.
Fullwidth letters, circled digits, superscript, Roman numeral, vulgar fraction and parenthesized digit. The fold drops separators produced by NFKC (U+2044 in 1/2, the parentheses of U+2474).
Full case folding expands U+00DF and U+1E9E to ss; capitals and sharp s fold to the same value.
Latin reference sentence (17 tokens).
Cyrillic а с о р (listed in confusables.txt) substituted in 8 words: folded values differ from the Latin sentence in every k-gram; skeleton values are identical.
Typographic punctuation: curly apostrophes and quotes, em dash, hyphenated compounds, parentheses. Apostrophes and hyphens separate.
The same words with ASCII and other punctuation only: identical hashes in every channel to plain-punct-a.
Decimal points, thousands separators and dates split numbers; Arabic-Indic digits are word characters and are not mapped to ASCII by NFKC.
A hyphen at a line break splits the word: exam-/ple gives exam, ple (stated limit; a SOFT HYPHEN would be transparent instead).
Source passage, 19 tokens.
Unrelated host with 17 consecutive source tokens (>= k + w - 1 = 15), capitalized and rewrapped: at least one shared folded and skeleton fingerprint is guaranteed.
Greek with final sigma: full case folding maps ς and Σ to σ. Skeleton maps several Greek letters to Latin prototypes.
Cyrillic, Arabic, Hebrew and Devanagari (with virama and vowel signs, General_Category Mn/Mc) words; danda and Arabic comma are separators.
Japanese without spaces: each Ideographic code point is one token; kana runs between ideographs form one token each.

records.description: Eight precomposed Hangul syllables separated by spaces.
The same syllables as conjoining jamo (NFD): folded recomposes them, so folded and skeleton equal plain-hangul.

Cherokee: UCD 17.0.0 NFKC_Casefold maps the small letters to the capitals (case folding goes to the older capitals for Cherokee). golang.org/x/text v0.39.0 cases.Fold leaves the small letters unchanged, so an implementation built on it diverges here.

Combining sequences: e + U+0301 + U+0323 (non-canonical order), alpha + U+0345 + U+0301 (non-canonical; U+0345 folds to iota), two overlay marks with equal ccc, and a token that starts with a combining mark.
Canonically equivalent spellings of plain-combining-a (precomposed U+1EB9 + U+0301, U+1FB4): folded and skeleton identical, exact differs.

Mixed-direction text with isolates (U+2067, U+2069), RLM and an RLO/PDF pair inside a word: bidi controls are Default_Ignorable, so they are outside spans at token edges and deleted inside tokens. Spans stay in logical (memory) order.

Code points new in Unicode 17.0.0: TELUGU LETTER NAKAARA POLLU (U+0C5C) inside a word, the new case pair U+A7CE/U+A7CF, and two CJK Extension J ideographs. Unicode 16.0 data has them unassigned, so a 16.0 library splits the first word and drops the rest.
U+048B folds to itself; its prototype is U+0439 U+0326, whose NFD is U+0438 U+0326 U+0306. The skeleton is applied once: U+0438 is not mapped again to U+1D0E.

U+FFFB INTERLINEAR ANNOTATION TERMINATOR and U+0600 ARABIC NUMBER SIGN are format characters (Cf) but not Default_Ignorable, so they are separators and split a word (stated limit: 32 such code points can split words invisibly).
plain-reflow-a with its first space replaced by NUL: the paired rejected input.
plain-reflow-a with its second space replaced by 0xFF: the paired rejected input.
Lone continuation byte.
Overlong encoding of '/'.
Encoded surrogate U+D800.
Truncated three-byte sequence at end of input.
Four-byte sequence above U+10FFFF.
NUL inside text.
NUL at 0 and an invalid byte at 7: the encoding check runs first.
The md-syntax bytes under text-plain: URLs, tag names and the entity name become tokens.
Exactly maxInputBytes = 16 bytes: accepted.
17 bytes: input-too-large at 0.
17 bytes including an invalid byte: the size check runs first.
